negative_reviews.text: Black garlic tonkotsu is great. But staff were underwhelming today. I understand they were busy, but I would have prefer they communicated more effectively instead of simply ignoring and avoiding eye contact with the people queuing. This was done by at least 5 members of staff, not only by the person hosting.
